result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and consistent. One minor cosmetic issue was found: the '-100%' discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card is ambiguous and could be misread as a price or an error rather than a free-item promotion.

issues.description: The badge on the pizza card reads '-100%', which is an unusual and potentially confusing way to express a free item or full discount. Users may not immediately understand it means the item is free.
issues.suggestion: Replace '-100%' with clearer wording such as 'FREE', '100% off', or 'Free item' to communicate the promotion unambiguously.
